steps.title: An object built by hand
steps.text: This page calls `forgeNew(Fn)`, the hand-written `new` from new.js. `Fn` sets `this.name = 'saber'`, so the console shows an `Fn` object with that name, between two `=== forge new ===` lines.
steps.textZh: 这个页面调用了 `forgeNew(Fn)`，也就是 new.js 里手写的 `new`。`Fn` 会设置 `this.name = 'saber'`，所以控制台在两行 `=== forge new ===` 之间显示一个带这个名字的 `Fn` 对象。

steps.title: instanceof, by hand
steps.text: `forgeInstanceof` walks the prototype chain one `Object.getPrototypeOf` at a time, looking for `Constructor.prototype`. A primitive such as `1` has no chain to walk, so the answer is `false` straight away.
steps.textZh: `forgeInstanceof` 沿着原型链，每次调用一次 `Object.getPrototypeOf`，寻找 `Constructor.prototype`。像 `1` 这样的原始值没有原型链可走，所以直接返回 `false`。

action.run: console.log('forgeInstanceof([], Array):', forgeInstanceof([], Array), '| forgeInstanceof(1, Number):', forgeInstanceof(1, Number))

steps.expectConsole: forgeInstanceof([], Array): true | forgeInstanceof(1, Number): false

steps.title: A closure keeps its own copy
steps.titleZh: 闭包记住自己的那一份
steps.text: closure.js has no page, so here is its idea with three timers each. With `let`, every turn of the loop gets a new `i`, and each callback remembers its own. With `var`, all callbacks share one `j`, which is already 3 when they run. To run the original, use `node fundamentals/javascript/closure.js`.
steps.textZh: closure.js 没有页面，这里用每组三个定时器演示它的思路。用 `let` 时，每一轮循环都会得到一个新的 `i`，每个回调记住自己的那一个；用 `var` 时，所有回调共用同一个 `j`，等它们运行时 `j` 已经是 3。想运行原来的文件，请执行 `node fundamentals/javascript/closure.js`。

action.run: for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) setTimeout(() => console.log('let i =', i), 60 * i); for (var j = 0; j < 3; j++) setTimeout(() => console.log('var j =', j), 60 * j + 30)
